## Install

1. Back up your saves (`Documents\Square Enix\FINAL FANTASY X&X-2 HD Remaster`).
2. Unpack the zip into your Fahrenheit folder, so the mod ends up in `mods\yuta.debugrevival\`.
3. Add a line `yuta.debugrevival` to `mods\loadorder`.
4. Start the game through Fahrenheit and press F9.

Needs Fahrenheit 1.0.0-alpha12 and the current Steam build of the game. The README in the mod folder explains every tab.
